verdicts.reason: A reads clearly from left to right (logo, then product, then quote), but it has problems: the quote mark floats far above the quote with a big empty gap, the attribution is jammed right under the quote, and the quote text runs into the right-hand decorative circle. B is scattered: the attribution sits at the far left, cut off from the quote it belongs to; the logo floats with no alignment in the lower middle; the product is shrunk to a tiny afterthought inside a cropped circle; and the quote mark and text don't share a clear edge.
